raw_text: ISRO's telemetry data centre in Bengaluru was targeted by a sophisticated cyber attack days after Chandrayaan-3's successful lunar landing, according to multiple sources. The attack used spear-phishing emails impersonating senior ISRO officials to gain initial access. CERT-In has issued an emergency advisory to all space sector entities. ISRO officials stated that mission-critical systems remained unaffected due to air-gap protections.
clean_text: ISRO Bengaluru data centre cyber attack confirmed via spear-phishing after Chandrayaan-3. CERT-In issued emergency advisory. Mission-critical systems unaffected due to air-gap.
